finding: The certified region is nonempty only at radii smaller than the vehicle own actuator-quantisation limit cycle. The certified ball is at most ~9 cm of position error and ~4.5 cm/s of velocity error (pure-axis extremes; the region is their intersection and so jointly smaller), while the minimum-pulse deadband sustains a steady offset of 2-9 cm. The closed loop therefore cannot remain inside the region it certifies, which is why recovery-active coverage is ~0% and the numerical guarantee is not useful on this platform.
what_would_fix_it: Finer thrust granularity: a smaller minimum impulse bit, a higher PWM rate, or proportional thrusters. The obstruction is actuator quantisation relative to the achievable per-step contraction, not the theory.
